title.narrative: Promoting Youth, Peace and Security in Somalia

description.narrative:
In line with UNESCO’s commitment to meaningfully engaging with youth in co-designing and co-delivery with young people and building on the successful approach for the development of a Joint Programme on Youth in Kenya, UNESCO, a non-resident agency in Somalia, will leverage on the seed funding provided under this activity to spearhead the development of a Joint Programme on Youth in Somalia, geared towards promoting youth-led peace and security in the country. This will also be an opportunity to affirm a presence and contribution within the Technical Working Group on youth co-led with UNFPA, to which UNESCO never attended a physical meeting, so far.
The co-design of a joint programme will consider and be informed by the following three steps: - A rapid mapping of key issues and ongoing UN programmes on youth peace and security, successes and shortcomings, including existing frameworks and instruments in Somalia - A dialogue with the UN and other key youth networks, partners and donors - Building of a stronger foundation for collaboration with the Ministry of Youth and Sports and having a better understanding of how they can work with other line ministries dealing with youth issues (education, health, employment, environment, ICT, etc.).
